title: GIG-3318: Raise MySQL Postmaclone Restore Timeout Past One Hour
description: Raises the mysql restore timeout from one hour to three so Hydra-sized dumps can finish on DigitalOcean managed MySQL after DEFINER sanitizing.

test_plan.description: Hydra restore is allowed to run past 60 minutes
steps: Confirm MysqlRestorer::RESTORE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is 10800 and is passed to MysqlRunner::run
After release, dispatch factory produce and confirm Hydra restore is still running after 61 minutes if it has not finished
